acceptance_signals: A strict versioned reservation marker and preview/result contract bind the existing replay-preflight plan digest, correlation identifier, expected and observed Git revision, Adapter identity and protocol, repository-relative marker path, and an all-denied replay, task, Git, release, deployment, and publication authority boundary.

Default CLI behavior is read-only and shows the exact create-only marker; non-interactive input, cancellation, malformed input, non-READY state, absent or unsafe registry directory, stale plan or repository state, and an existing marker create no marker and modify no repository content.

Only exact interactive human confirmation can request apply; apply re-evaluates the same replay-preflight plan immediately before writing and uses exclusive file creation so a race collision never overwrites an existing marker.

A successful apply creates exactly one bounded local marker and returns reserved status while explicitly stating that reservation does not admit a task, authorize a replay, launch a model session, or grant repository, Git, publication, release, or deployment authority.

Fixture tests cover preview, successful reservation, cancellation, redirected input, stale revision or target state, Adapter mismatch, missing registry directory, pre-existing marker, and exclusive-create race behavior.

Documentation connects preflight, reservation, replay, and DS Harness Contract v1 as separate stages sharing correlation identity without changing Harness Contract v1 semantics or claiming real-consumer or product-effectiveness evidence.

Focused and complete supported-Python tests, task and repository governance, pre-pause scope reconciliation, JSON and Schema checks, secret-safety inspection, bounded current-Agent self-review, and git diff check complete with unresolved gaps reported.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-b20b289a71e94fb2b3973df17178b113 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control. On 2026-08-16 the bounded development-source preview, marker, result, CLI, Schema, tests, and documentation completed. All 868 supported-Python tests passed with 2 platform-limited skips, governance had no deterministic failure, and native current-Agent advisory review srv-6a3f3d55584e3cfce3da1893f9851d46 found no correction-required drift. The task is paused so it cannot authorize installation, a real-consumer marker, replay, Harness semantic change, Git operation, publication, release, deployment, or follow-on work.

requirement.summary: Add a dependency-free, versioned, local correlation-reservation contract and low-level CLI that previews one exact marker after a READY replay preflight, requires explicit interactive human confirmation, revalidates the same plan and repository state immediately before an exclusive create, and never launches or authorizes a replay.

items: Reservation could be misrepresented as replay authorization or task admission.
A stale preview or race could overwrite or bind the wrong marker unless apply revalidates and writes exclusively.
Creating a missing registry directory during apply could violate zero-write failure semantics, so the directory must pre-exist.
Broad documentation edits could accidentally merge preflight, reservation, and DS Harness responsibilities.
Existing unrelated .codex content, cover image, AIRBNB task, disposable-preflight task, and experiment record must remain untouched.
Reviewed assumption: The registry directory must already exist as a trustworthy local directory so failure paths never need to create scaffolding before the exclusive marker write.
Reviewed assumption: A low-level exact interactive confirmation is an acceptable development and recovery interface while final product UX remains a native human decision surface.

Reviewed assumption: Re-evaluating the plan immediately before exclusive creation is sufficient for this bounded slice even though it cannot make repository state and later replay execution one atomic transaction.
Reviewed assumption: DS Harness Contract v1 remains the downstream post-run evaluator and requires no schema or runtime change in this task.
Reviewed unknown: The final public command spelling may require a small implementation choice while preserving separate preview and apply semantics.
Reviewed unknown: A future host-native form may replace the low-level terminal confirmation without changing the reservation contract.
Reviewed unknown: A later replay launcher may require a separate consume or release transition for a reservation marker.

title: Implement human-controlled replay correlation reservation
